capability_classifier_analysis.current_state: fed_intent_classifier.py exists at KVM8 AAA/federation/. It is a shadow-intent classifier (4-tier: explicit signal, asset binding, refusal risk, privacy boundary). It does NOT classify workload intent (vision/code/reasoning/conversation).
capability_classifier_analysis.what_wawa_needs: A capability classifier that maps message intent to FED capability signature (fed-reasoning-heavy, fed-multimodal-vision, etc.)
capability_classifier_analysis.gap: fed_intent_classifier.py detects shadow/privacy intent, not workload intent. Different problem.
capability_classifier_analysis.proposal: Create capability_classifier.py as a new module that maps message intent to FED capability signatures, then wire it into Hermes gateway model override.

i_azwa_analysis.structure: Mirrors i-ARIF.json schema with Azwa-specific values
i_azwa_analysis.critical_note: i-AZWA is a spec, not a runtime. It has no actuator. Same problem as Wawa's SOUL.md — doctrine without enforcement.
i_azwa_analysis.sovereign_chain: F13-Azwa is NOT the same as F13-Arif. i-AZWA.json correctly identifies Azwa as sovereign holder, but Arif's delegation is advisory only. This is correct separation of powers.
i_azwa_analysis.missing: Runtime implementation, model routing, scar ledger integration, memory persistence

fed_intent_classifier.py is shadow-intent. Wawa needs workload-intent classifier. This is Option B — actual code that intercepts and routes.
recommendations.deliverable: capability_classifier.py with intent → capability signature mapping

recommendations.reason: Hermes needs runtime model override capability. Without this, all routing is static config.

final_verdict: HOLD — Wawa's doctrine is correct but has no actuator. Capability classifier and i-AZWA are specs, not runtimes. The gap between doctrine and enforcement is the same gap between 'Identity Rich, Capability Blind'. Before sealing anything, implement the routing mechanism.
one_line: Wawa wrote the right doctrine but has no way to execute it. Doctrine without actuator is decoration.
